hero.description: Analytical instruments and technical support for laboratories and industry.

company.title: Dedicated Analytical Instrumentation Partner for Indonesian Industry
company.paragraph1: Established in 2022 as part of the PT Dynatech International Group, PT Ascentia Arsya Analitika brings nearly two decades of engineering and distribution heritage to analytical laboratories across Indonesia.
company.paragraph2: From our headquarters in Jakarta and regional support facility in Kendari, we deliver specialized sample preparation systems, X-ray technologies, and certified reference materials (CRMs) to mining, cement, petrochemical, and academic research leaders.

visionMission.visionDesc: The benchmark analytical partner for Indonesian laboratories and heavy industry.
visionMission.visionDetail: To set the national standard for analytical accuracy, equipment reliability, and rapid engineering support across Indonesia’s industrial and research laboratories.
visionMission.missionDesc: Uncompromising instrument precision, method optimization, and on-site support.
visionMission.missionDetail: To empower testing facilities with authorized global instruments, genuine consumables, and on-site application training from our Jakarta and Kendari hubs.

locations.title: Support, within reach
locations.description: Facilities in Jakarta and Kendari provide application consulting, fast consumable dispatch, and on-site engineering across Indonesia.

gallery.title: People, spaces, and analytical work
gallery.description: With locations in Jakarta and Kendari, Ascentia supports laboratories and industrial operations with faster turnaround and on-site expertise.

partners.title: Specialist technology. Applied expertise
partners.description: We represent leading brands in analytical instrumentation, sample preparation, certified reference materials, and precision measurement.
